name: Fold & Put Away
shortDescription: Fold clean laundry and return it to its usual household storage.
detailedDescription: We will fold or hang your clean laundry and put everything away in the right places, clearing the basket or pile that has been waiting.
customerPrerequisites: Brief orientation on where items belong
serviceProcess: This is a pilot service. Request through the early access form. Parentive will confirm availability and schedule your visit.
importantNotes: Laundry should already be clean and dry
Covers one standard basket or equivalent
